chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever applies kohl with a stick from an intoxicant, Allah will apply kohl to him with a stick of fire.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.بِمِيلٍ: with a kohl stick or applicator
key_terms.كَحَلَهُ: He will apply kohl to him
key_terms.نَارٍ: fire, referring to punishment in the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about applying kohl with an intoxicant?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against using an intoxicant even in the form of kohl application. It emphasizes the gravity of engaging with what is haram by describing a punishment of fire in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4947 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever applies kohl with a stick dipped in an intoxicant, Allah will apply a stick of fire to his eyes."
